title: Asiad: Nesthy Petecio stops foe, marches to quarterfinals
summary: Filipina boxer Nesthy Petecio opened her Asian Games campaign with a dominant victory over Jordan's Mays Alreem Abukhadijah in the women's 60kg class, Saturday afternoon at the Nishio Gymnasium.
